quarry-cargo-no-space: This cargo needs a continuous free area of the right size. Clear nearby cargo and passengers, or use a larger vehicle.
carryon:pick-up-failed-loggingmod:trunk-: The trunk inventory is empty or its wood data is invalid; it cannot be picked up.
carryon:place-down-failed-loggingmod:tru: The trunk inventory is empty or its wood data is invalid. Use /vsscpmod trunkrelease to release it as a carried entity and unlock your hands.
trunk-release-unavailable: Unable to spawn a carried entity. Your carried trunk has been retained.
trunk-release-none: You are not carrying a Logging trunk in your hands.
trunk-release-ok: Released the trunk beside you and unlocked your hands, preserving its remaining inventory data.
trunk-release-empty: Unlocked your hands and retained the trunk as an entity. Its log data is already missing; the original quantity cannot be restored automatically.
info-command-disabled: Precise time and coordinates are restricted. Administrators can use /vsscpmod info off for their own session.
info-admin-only: This command requires an administrator player.
info-config-reload-failed: Information restriction config reload failed; the previous setting remains active.
info-restricted: Your precise time and coordinate information is restricted.
info-unrestricted: Your information restrictions are disabled until you disconnect.
handbook-detail-incomplete: Some handbook data could not be displayed ({0}). The available content is preserved. See client-main.log for the affected item or mod; reopen this page after loading completes.
stack-repair-none: Your active stack has no repairable RKN phantom durability. Hold an ordinary item with the incorrect gray bar and try again.
stack-repair-success: Removed phantom durability from your active stack. It can now merge with otherwise identical normal items.
quarry-carry-help: Rock blocks in this stack: {0}. Walking stops when the total carried load reaches {1} blocks.
quarry-backpack-help: A slab containing at least {0} rock blocks requires a backpack slot, one slab per slot. Select that slot to place it.
quarry-carry-actions-help: Carry at most {1} slab(s); more prevents walking. At {0} rock blocks, carry at half speed or slower with no sprinting, jumping on land, gliding or boarding vehicles/mounts; swimming ascent remains available. Place slabs on the ground or load vehicle cargo points. Taking a heavy slab after boarding dismounts you.
quarry-carry-mount-blocked: Your carried slabs are too heavy to board or ride. Place them on the ground, then load them onto vehicle cargo points.
skill-unavailable: No current data. Waiting for synchronization.
skill-gate-inactive: Body action restrictions are currently inactive.
skill-gate-blocked: Body state currently blocks this action; skills cannot override it.
skill-physiology-fallback: Invalid value; the normal factor is used.
skill-timing-disabled: Skill acceleration is disabled; its factor is normal.
skill-scope-miningSpeedMul: Native mining multiplier × current body mining factor. Tool/material base speed is separate; disabled hands cannot mine.
skill-scope-meleeWeaponsDamage: Native melee multiplier, including the additive body source. Weapon base damage is separate; hand restrictions take priority.
skill-scope-meleeTiming: Optional Leveling animation speed × body animation speed; not attacks per second for every weapon. The Leveling factor is ×1 when disabled.
skill-scope-rangedWeaponsDamage: Native ranged damage stat. Projectile base damage, weapon implementation and target defense are separate. This stat cannot override a body bow restriction.
skill-scope-rangedWeaponsAcc: Accuracy stat used by native aiming, not hit probability. Weapon, movement and injury still affect aiming.
skill-scope-bowDrawingStrength: Projectile launch-speed multiplier used by native bows; not linear range or hit chance.
skill-scope-bowTiming: Optional Leveling draw-time reduction converted to progress speed, multiplied by the body bow factor. Body denial still prevents drawing.
skill-scope-walkspeed: Native blended movement stat, including body, class, skills and equipment. Stance, terrain and vehicles are separate.
skill-scope-hungerrate: SLSS already reads this multiplier for energy demand; lower means less demand. Hunger leveling retains its original fullness threshold.
skill-scope-healingeffectivness: SLSS already reads this healing multiplier. Actual recovery also depends on nutrition, wounds and body state; see the recovery metrics.
skill-scope-maxhealthExtraPoints: Native extra-health stat offset, already included by SLSS in maximum health. This is neither current health nor total maximum health.
skill-scope-armorDurabilityLoss: Armor durability loss on impact; lower means longer life, not damage reduction.
skill-scope-armorWalkSpeedAffectedness: Multiplier on negative armor movement penalties; lower reduces the penalty. It is not a direct speed bonus.
skill-scope-mechanicalsDamage: Additional damage multiplier against mechanical targets, multiplied into melee or projectile damage before target defenses.
skill-scope-animalLootDropRate: Native animal harvest loot multiplier; drop tables and rounding are separate.
skill-scope-animalHarvestingTime: Native harvest-time factor: ×0.75 is 25% less time (×1.333 speed), not 25% more speed.
skill-scope-forageDropRate: Native forage drop multiplier, only for targets that consume this stat.
skill-scope-wildCropDropRate: Native wild-crop drop multiplier; does not change growth speed.
skill-scope-oreDropRate: Native ore drop multiplier; claustrophobic penalties and cancellation retain their original rules.
skill-scope-rustyGearDropRate: Native rusty-gear drop multiplier; drop tables are separate.
skill-scope-vesselContentsDropRate: Native vessel-content drop multiplier, separate from whole-vessel chance.
skill-scope-wholeVesselLootChance: Native whole-vessel drop chance (stat minus one, bounded to 0–100%).
skill-scope-animalSeekingRange: Native animal target-seeking range multiplier; lower is less detectable, not invisibility.
skill-scope-temporalGearTLRepairCost: Stat offset to temporal gears needed for translocator repair; negative reduces cost. Base cost and random rounding are separate.
skill-scope-unlocks: Unlock states synchronized by Leveling. Recipes, equipment and interactions remain owned by Leveling; no rewards are granted again.
skill-combined-sources: These sources use their own combination rules; the final effect is authoritative.
